idea-plugin.name: CodeBuddy
idea-plugin.description: A tutor in your Mac's notch. Write #? question or #!teoria topic on its own line and press Enter: the question and the code around it go to the local CodeBuddy brain, and the answer shows up in the notch. The plugin never edits your code, except for the "CodeBuddy: Clear Triggers" action.

action.description: Remove every #? and #!teoria line from this file
